system: Cedar Service release 1 (CedarServiceCore, CedarConnectors, func-cedar-fieldlink, func-cedar-ops)

flows.name: Dataverse plug-in -> Service Bus topic cedar-workorder-events (C-48)

notApplicable.R: Messages carry correlationid and Dataverse audit records the change that raised them (C-15)

notApplicable.E: Cedar holds only a FieldLink client credential scoped to job creation; no privilege to elevate on the Cedar side

flows.name: Cedar Service Assistant -> agent flow -> Dataverse (C-24, C-43)

notApplicable.D: Copilot Studio and Dataverse service protection limits apply; covered by AL-08 success-rate alert

flows.name: Release pipeline -> Cedar-Prod (Cedar Release Pipeline, C-18)

threats.title: Attacker posts fake status updates pretending to be FieldLink
controls: Entra ID authentication on the function (Easy Auth), FieldLink app role Status.Write required
Caller object id checked against FieldLink Sync
threats.evidence: tests/Cedar.Service.FieldLink.Tests CallerClaims tests + 401 smoke in Cedar-Test

threats.title: Status body altered to complete a job that is not finished
controls: TLS only
Status transition rules (no Completed from Sent) in StatusRules
Upsert by FieldLink ID only

threats.title: FieldLink denies having sent a rejected status
controls: StatusReceived telemetry with fieldLinkId and time (C-20)
Dataverse auditing on cedar_fieldlinkstatus

threats.title: Error responses leak internal details
controls: Problem details without stack traces
No customer data in responses

threats.title: Flood of requests exhausts the function and Dataverse API limits
controls: Queue between endpoint and Dataverse writes
Flex Consumption maximum instance count
AL-02 alert

threats.title: Endpoint identity has more Dataverse privileges than needed
controls: Application user FieldLink Sync with custom role: update cedar_workorder status columns only

threats.title: Other sender publishes to the topic
controls: SAS policy dataverse-send with Send only, scoped to the topic
Subscribers validate source attribute

threats.title: Message changed in transit or replayed
controls: TLS
Idempotent consumer by event id (lesson 96)

threats.title: SAS key leaked from service endpoint registration or repository
controls: Key only in the service endpoint registration, never in Git
scan-secrets SEC-02 in the Build stage
Key rotation every 90 days
threats.evidence: scan-secrets OK in build 2026-10-05; rotation runbook docs/operations/runbooks/rotate-sas.md

threats.title: Topic fills because consumers are stopped
controls: Time to live 14 days
AL-03 dead-letter alert

threats.title: Plug-in managed identity granted broad Azure roles
controls: Managed identity for plug-ins (C-29) with only the roles it needs

threats.title: Cedar sends jobs to a spoofed FieldLink host
controls: Host from environment variable cedar_FieldLinkApiHost per environment
HTTPS certificate validation

threats.title: Job payload modified by a compromised intermediate
controls: TLS 1.2+

threats.title: FieldLink claims a job was never received
controls: DispatchSent event after 2xx
Nightly reconciliation (C-53)

threats.title: Customer contact details sent to FieldLink beyond need
controls: Contract sends site address and access notes only; no customer phone or e-mail
Contract review in pull requests

threats.title: FieldLink outage blocks dispatch
controls: Asynchronous queue with retries
Phone fallback in runbook AL-01

threats.title: Session token stolen from the browser
controls: Entra ID sign-in with Conditional Access and MFA
No tokens in localStorage in Cedar code

threats.title: User edits records beyond their role through the API
controls: Server-side security roles and C-09 rules; UI checks are convenience only

threats.title: User denies changing a scheduled time
controls: Auditing on cedar_scheduledfor

threats.title: Script injection exfiltrates data to another origin
controls: Code app CSP enforced, connect-src limited (C-23 v0.4)
No eval or innerHTML with data

threats.title: Heavy client queries throttle the user
controls: Performance budget C-61

threats.title: Code app shared with everyone gives access to data sources
controls: Share only with Cedar Field Coordination team
Data access still bound by Dataverse roles

threats.title: Anonymous user talks to the agent
controls: Authenticate with Microsoft

threats.title: Prompt injection makes the agent call a write tool
controls: Agent tools are read-only except dispatch request with human confirmation
Deterministic checks in the flow, not in instructions
Evaluation set includes injections (C-60)

threats.title: Agent tool runs as service principal and reveals rows the user cannot see
controls: Agent flow returns only status fields for one work order number
No customer contact data in outputs

threats.title: Maker edits the published agent in production
controls: Managed solution in Cedar-Prod, no maker role for Karim

threats.title: Pipeline service connection used from an unapproved pipeline
controls: Service connection restricted to build-and-release.yml
No Cedar-Prod service connection; production only through Cedar Release Pipeline with approval

threats.title: Unreviewed code reaches the build
controls: main protected: 1 reviewer + build validation
Solution checker High = 0

threats.title: Nobody can tell who approved a production release
controls: Lina's approval recorded by Cedar – Production approval flow
Deployment notes cite REL-###

threats.title: Secrets printed in pipeline logs
controls: Secret pipeline variables from Key Vault
scan-secrets masks previews
Secure inputs and outputs on flow actions

threats.title: Deployer identity is System Administrator in every environment
controls: cedar-pipelines-deployer is System Administrator only in Cedar-Prod, used only by the delegated deployment
threats.evidence: Accepted 2026-10-05: required by delegated deployment; reviewed quarterly
